subtitulo: Marketing emails. Everyone who confirms their account joins the audience and starts the welcome journey. The key is stored encrypted; anything you don't set here comes from the server's .env.
ayudaActivo: New sign-ups join the audience and every uploaded video sends an event.
ayudaApagado: Nothing is sent to Mailchimp: the key or the audience is missing.

clave.reemplazar: Paste a new key to replace it
clave.donde: In Mailchimp: Profile → Extras → API keys. It ends with the data center (…-us15).

journey.ayuda: A journey whose starting point is "API trigger": it starts when someone confirms their account. Paste the trigger URL Mailchimp gives you or type journey/step (35/99).
journey.sin: No journey: only the se_registro event is sent.
journey.pegar: To change it: paste the trigger URL or type 35/99
journey.noActivo: Until it's active in Mailchimp, new sign-ups don't enter the journey.
journey.confirmarQuitar: Remove the journey? New sign-ups stop entering it (unless the .env has one).

pasos: Sign in to Mailchimp with the Clipfine account. Click your photo (top right) → Profile → Extras → API keys → Create A Key. Copy all of it: it ends with the data center (for example …-us15). Mailchimp shows it only once.
Paste it below in "API key" and click Save. Clipfine checks it with Mailchimp before saving; if it's rejected, nothing is saved.
Choose the audience (Clipfine's is "Clipfine.io") and Save. Everyone who confirms their account joins it, with first name, last name and language.

In Mailchimp, build the welcome journey: Automations → Customer Journeys → Create journey → choose "API trigger" as the starting point. Mailchimp shows a URL ending in …/journeys/35/steps/99/actions/trigger.
Paste that URL below in "Welcome journey" and Save (typing just 35/99 works too). Clipfine checks the journey exists and shows its name and status.
Add the emails to the journey and turn it on in Mailchimp. While it says Draft, new sign-ups don't enter it.
Test it: sign up a new account with one of your emails, confirm it and check in Mailchimp that the contact shows up in the audience and enters the journey.
importante: Only new sign-ups from the moment this is set up join automatically. Earlier ones must be imported in Mailchimp (Audience → Import contacts).
People who join through a team invitation don't go to the audience: they work for a client who already pays.
Every uploaded video sends the video_subido event. It can start another journey with an "Event" starting point, if you want.
One-off campaigns (for example, the Monday and Wednesday ones) are sent from Mailchimp to the whole audience; they don't depend on this screen.
If someone unsubscribed, signing up again doesn't resubscribe them.
The clipfine.io domain is already authenticated in Mailchimp (DKIM). If the sender moves to another domain, authenticate it first or emails will bounce.
What you set here wins over the server variables (.env). Removing a value goes back to the server's, if any.
Product notices (codes, invitations, summaries) don't go through Mailchimp: Clipfine still sends them.
